outline.title: Ada and the No-Air Planet
outline.logline: Ada meets an eagle who lands in her bathtub ocean and cannot fly, then helps it find a new way to move using her submarine toy.
outline.theme: trying a different way when the first one will not work

characters.name: Ada
characters.description: A six-year-old girl who wants to explore the ocean in her bathtub with her toy submarine.

characters.name: Finn
characters.description: An eagle who wants to live on the new planet but must learn what works when there is no air.

beats.title: Bathtub ocean
beats.summary: Ada sails her toy submarine across the warm water. She pretends the tub is a deep ocean full of places to explore.

beats.title: The eagle arrives
beats.summary: Finn the eagle splashes down beside the submarine. He says he has found a brand-new planet and wants to live here.

beats.title: First try to fly
beats.summary: Wings need air to push against, so Eli tries again and fails at the edge of the water.

beats.title: Second try to fly
beats.summary: Wings need air to push against, so Eli tries again and fails at the edge of the water.

beats.title: The bathtub experiment
beats.summary: Ada watches and thinks. She pushes her submarine under the water, then lets it rise and glide along the surface. She shows Finn how the toy moves without wings.

beats.title: Finn tries the new way
beats.summary: Wings need air to push against, so Eli tries again and fails at the edge of the water.

beats.title: Together on the planet
beats.summary: Ada steers the submarine beside Finn. They sail slow circles through the tub until it is time to drain the ocean. Finn stays afloat and happy.
